title: Eyes Wide Open, Brain Half
style:
Suno v5.5 Prompt (copy & paste ready)
textAtmospheric cool jazz at 98 BPM with a late-night, smoky, and introspective feel. Soft brushed drums, warm piano, upright bass, and subtle horns. Male or female vocalist with a relaxed, slightly dreamy delivery. Lyrics about being physically present but mentally drifting. Light, sparse scat in the middle section. Moody, cinematic, and moody jazz production with a classic cool jazz atmosphere.
Complete track handed over.
This one has that late-night, half-awake jazz club feeling you described.
lyrics:
[Intro – Soft piano and brushed drums]
Eyes wide open…
Brain half shut…
Yeah…
[Verse 1]
The lights are low and the hour is late
The music’s moving but I’m in a different state
My body’s here but my mind’s somewhere else
Floating through the sound like I’m beside myself
[Pre-Chorus]
I should probably go but I can’t seem to leave
The rhythm’s got a hold and it’s hard to believe
[Chorus]
Eyes wide open, brain half shut
Caught in the middle, can’t get enough
The music keeps playing, the night keeps on
Eyes wide open, but most of me’s gone
[Verse 2]
People all around but they feel far away
I’m nodding to the beat in my own kind of way
The bass is walking and the piano sings
I’m here in the room but I’m lost in the strings
[Chorus]
Eyes wide open, brain half shut
Half in the moment, half in my gut
The horns are crying and the drums keep time
Eyes wide open… but I’m barely online
[Scat Break – Dreamy and sparse]
Doo-bee-doo… wah…
Brain half shut…
Bee-boo-bop… eyes wide open…
Scat… scat… drifting off…
[Bridge]
Maybe it’s the hour, maybe it’s the sound
Maybe I don’t wanna come back down
The night feels endless and the music is kind
So I’ll stay a little longer with my half-closed mind
[Final Chorus – Softer and warmer]
Eyes wide open, brain half shut
Still in the pocket, still in the cut
The song keeps spinning and I’m still around
Eyes wide open… but I’m halfway out
[Outro – Fading]
Eyes wide open…
Brain half shut…
Jazz in the blood…
And the night won’t stop…
